name: Kira Brookheart
source:
Though sweet on the surface Kira can be rather sarcastic at times, especially to those she's comfortable around.

Kira seems to be rather shy at first glance, usually due to her positive nature. When she turned eighteen, Kira took over her mother's papersmithing workshop and spends her days between crafting and selling her works. Living alone with her bird, [url=/c69563]Loveless[/url], Kira spends a lot of time at her best friend's house or at her workshop.

[From in-game]
